notes_for_editor: Thin record. The register and firelookout.com agree on 1951 and gone by 1963, and both look like they draw on the same survey, so they are not independent. The brief's 'mobile' kind matches the trailer-cupola wording; the register does not say how the cupola was moved, and the story now says so rather than inferring a lookout room. The Forest Fire Lookout Association list, not firelookout.com, is the source for 'Trailer Gone'. No staffing, fires, access or current-condition source was found. A search snippet mentioned a ghost town of the same name in Umatilla County, but no page on it was read, so it is not used. The brief's access 'unknown' is kept out of facts because no source supports a level.
